title: gastrorchis lutea var. geffrayi
intro: Gastrorchis lutea var. geffrayi, commonly known as the yellow orchid, is a species of orchid native to the tropical forests of Madagascar. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gastrorchis lutea var. geffrayi include wound healing, antidiabetic, and antifungal activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Research has identified the presence of these bioactive compounds, which are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
